description: Partner pack for Lens Protocol — decentralized social graph on Lens Chain (zkEVM L2). Biases toward social apps, creator platforms, and feeds that want portable identity + content ownership.

defaults.headline: Build on Lens — portable social graph
defaults.subheadline: Decentralized profiles, follows, and content on Lens Chain. Users own their graph — you own the UX.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Lens, social graph, decentralized social, creator platform, or portable profiles/follows across apps.
firstSteps: Install @lens-protocol/client for TS or use the GraphQL API directly (https://api.lens.xyz). API keys optional but recommended for rate limits.
Authentication uses SIWE (Sign-In With Ethereum) — reuse the existing viem/wagmi flow; don't build a separate auth stack.
For posting content (publications), sign a typed-data message and submit through the Lens API — gasless via Lens relayer by default.
gotchas: Lens v3 runs on Lens Chain (its own zkEVM L2) — chainId 232. The v2 Polygon deployment is deprecated; don't read Polygon Lens contracts for new work.
Profile ownership and content are separate NFTs — handle each in token metadata flows; losing profile access ≠ losing published posts.
The GraphQL API is the primary interface; direct contract reads work but miss the indexed view (mirrors, reactions, feed ranking).
